long_biography.plain_text:
Centria Healthcare began in 2009 as Scott Barry's home-care business in Michigan. He expanded it into autism therapy, pediatric nursing and catastrophic-injury support, becoming one of the country's largest providers of applied behavior analysis. A partnership with Martis Capital in 2016 accelerated that growth, and the company completed a second recapitalization with Thomas H. Lee Partners three years later.

Barry studied marketing at Michigan State University and later earned a master's degree in applied behavior analysis from National University. He moved from Centria's chief executive role to chair its board, focusing on real-estate expansion and clinical outcomes. Barry has since co-founded Northern Shore Capital, where his healthcare operating background informs new investments and board work.
long_biography.html:
Centria Healthcare began in 2009 as Scott Barry's home-care business in Michigan. He expanded it into autism therapy, pediatric nursing and catastrophic-injury support, becoming one of the country's largest providers of applied behavior analysis. A partnership with Martis Capital in 2016 accelerated that growth, and the company completed a second recapitalization with Thomas H. Lee Partners three years later.

Barry studied marketing at Michigan State University and later earned a master's degree in applied behavior analysis from National University. He moved from Centria's chief executive role to chair its board, focusing on real-estate expansion and clinical outcomes. Barry has since co-founded Northern Shore Capital, where his healthcare operating background informs new investments and board work.
